sentences.ar: قعدت عالأرض، وسيلفر قدامي، وحواليّ رجاله.
sentences.en: I sat on the floor, Silver before me, his men around me.

sentences.ar: قال سيلفر: يا جيم، أنا دايماً حبيتك.
sentences.en: Silver said: Jim, I always liked you.
You are like me.
Your friends left you.
The doctor said: the boy?
We do not want him.
I said: a lie.

sentences.ar: قال سيلفر: مبارح إجا الدكتور بعلم أبيض.
sentences.en: Silver said: yesterday the doctor came with a white flag.
And he said: it is over, the ship is gone.

sentences.ar: وأعطانا القلعة، والأكل، وشرط واحد: ما نلحقهم.
sentences.en: And he gave us the stockade, the food, and one condition: we do not follow them.
And they went.
And I do not know where.
I did not understand, but kept silent.

sentences.ar: قال سيلفر: فإنت معنا، ولا ضدنا.
sentences.en: Silver said: so you are with us, or against us.
Choose.

sentences.ar: وحسيت إنه لازم أحكي، وإلا بموت من الخوف.
sentences.en: And I felt I must speak, or die of fear.

sentences.ar: فقلت: أنا اللي كنت بالبرميل، وسمعت كل كلمة.
sentences.en: So I said: I was the one in the apple barrel, and I heard every word.

sentences.ar: وأنا اللي قطعت حبل السفينة، وقتلت هاندز.
sentences.en: And I am the one who cut the ship's rope, and killed Hands.

sentences.ar: والسفينة بمكان ما بتعرفوه، وما رح تشوفوها.
sentences.en: And the ship is in a place you do not know, and you will not see her.

sentences.ar: اقتلوني إذا بدكم، أو خلوني حي، وبشهد لكم بالمحكمة.
sentences.en: Kill me if you like, or keep me alive, and I testify for you in court.
There was silence.

sentences.ar: وبعدين قام واحد وهو بيسحب سكين، وقال: أنا بقتله.
sentences.en: And then one got up drawing a knife, and said: I will kill him.
Silver said: stay where you are.
I am captain here.
And whoever touches the boy fights me.
His men began whispering, and looking at him.
And one said: we want to talk outside.

sentences.ar: وطلعوا الستة، وتركوني مع سيلفر لحالنا.
sentences.en: And the six went out, and left me alone with Silver.

sentences.ar: قال سيلفر بصوت واطي: يا جيم، إنت قريب من الموت.
sentences.en: Silver said in a low voice: Jim, you are close to death.
And so am I.
My men want to throw me out, because I protected you.

sentences.ar: بس اسمع: أنا بحميك، وإنت بتحمي جون سيلفر من المشنقة.
sentences.en: But listen: I protect you, and you protect John Silver from the gallows.
I said: I do what I can.
He said: agreed.
And then he said, looking into the fire:

sentences.ar: الدكتور أعطاني إشي كمان، غير القلعة.
sentences.en: The doctor gave me something else, besides the stockade.
He gave me the map.

sentences.ar: وطلعها من جيبه، وأنا ما فهمت إشي.
sentences.en: And he took it from his pocket, and I understood nothing.
